title: Dummy estimator comparison protected reference solution and review guide
answer: A strong submission for Dummy estimator comparison should complete this objective: Compare a basic model with a dummy baseline. It should demonstrate the expected outcome (Establish minimum performance.), use a consistent and reproducible setup, report evidence rather than speculation, and address the limitation: Use the same validation strategy for baseline and candidate.
explanation: Review the result for technical correctness and reproducibility. The automatic check only looks for DummyClassifier, cross_val_score and does not run the learner code. Use the same validation strategy for baseline and candidate.
